user.title: Connect to NEIS
user.description: You can use limited mode without an API key, but timetables or academic schedules may be incomplete. For reliable operation, [request a free API key]({api_key_url}).

data.limited_ack: I understand that data can be incomplete without an API key

school.title: Find a school
school.description: Choose an education office and enter part or all of the school name.

grade.title: Select a grade
grade.description:
**{school_name}** · {school_address}

Select the grade for the {academic_year} academic year. In January and February, use the grade from the previous calendar year.

class.title: Select a class
class.description:
**{school_name}** · {school_address}

Select a class for the {academic_year} academic year. Change the grade and submit to load its classes. If the list could not be loaded, submit the same grade to retry. In limited mode, enter the class name manually.

meals.title: Select meals

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to NEIS
reauth_confirm.description: The existing key was rejected. Enter a new [free API key]({api_key_url}) or confirm limited mode.

data.limited_ack: Use limited mode without an API key

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure NEIS
reconfigure.description: Enter a new [free API key]({api_key_url}) or switch to limited mode.

data.limited_ack: Use limited mode without an API key

meals_limited.title: Select meals

error.api_error: NEIS rejected the request. Check the API key and input.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to NEIS. Your input is retained; try again shortly.
error.class_not_found: No record matches this academic year, grade, and class. Check the grade and class. Data for the new academic year may not be published yet.
error.incomplete_data: The full result could not be retrieved. Enter a free API key if you do not have one configured, or try again later if you already use a key.
error.invalid_auth: The NEIS API key is invalid or restricted.
error.limited_not_acknowledged: Acknowledge the limitation or enter an API key.
error.rate_limited: The NEIS daily request limit has been reached. Try again tomorrow.
error.school_not_found: No supported school was found. Refine the school name.
error.incomplete_school_search: Only part of the search results was returned. Enter a more specific school name and search again.
error.classes_unavailable: No classes were returned for this grade. The school may not have published this academic year yet. Check the grade or try again later.

abort.already_configured: The same school, grade, and class is already configured.
abort.unknown: Setup could not continue. Start again.

init.title: NEIS School options
init.description:
**{school_name}** · Academic year {academic_year}

Update the grade, class, or enabled meal types. If data for the new academic year is not published yet, try again later. Use Reconfigure on the integration to change the API key.
